description.en: Start with one panel record, connect drawing and data, then follow a rule into a changing system. Explore four design approaches when ready.
description.sr: Počni od zapisa jednog panela, poveži crtež i podatke, pa prati pravilo do promenljive celine. Zatim istraži četiri pristupa dizajnu.

limit.en: Teaching geometry and quantities; no connection strength, structural approval or manufacturing validation.
limit.sr: Nastavna geometrija i količine; bez čvrstine spojeva, potvrde konstrukcije ili provere proizvodnje.

description.en: See the line, state and consequence. Four instruments, one way of thinking.
description.sr: Vidi naredbu, stanje i posledicu. Četiri instrumenta, jedan način razmišljanja.

limit.en: The instruments expose selected calculations and traces; they are not a general student-code editor or a debugger for arbitrary programs.
limit.sr: Instrumenti prikazuju izabrane račune i tragove; nisu opšti editor studentskog koda ili debugger proizvoljnog programa.

description.en: Build an invented layer model. Follow quantities and distinguish evidence from a story.
description.sr: Gradi izmišljeni slojeviti model. Prati količine i razlikuj dokaz od priče.

limit.en: Invented cells and work assumptions; neither a historical reconstruction nor a verified building process.
limit.sr: Izmišljene ćelije i pretpostavke rada; nisu istorijska rekonstrukcija ili potvrđen postupak građenja.

description.en: A kinetic facade and an ideal cantilever: change one input, inspect the result.
description.sr: Kinetička fasada i idealna konzola: promeni jedan ulaz, pogledaj rezultat.

limit.en: Idealised geometry and cantilever calculations within the stated assumptions; no real structural design check.
limit.sr: Idealizovana geometrija i račun konzole u navedenim pretpostavkama; bez provere stvarne konstrukcije.

description.en: An arc, a dome and the cost of a finer mesh.
description.sr: Luk, kupola i cena gušće mreže.

limit.en: A discretised geometric representation; a finer mesh does not establish measured accuracy or constructability.
limit.sr: Diskretizovan geometrijski prikaz; gušća mreža ne potvrđuje izmerenu tačnost ili izvodljivost.

description.en: Explore an ideal plane truss and its boundary conditions.
description.sr: Istraži idealnu ravansku rešetku i njene granične uslove.

limit.en: An ideal plane-truss model under stated supports and loads; no member, joint or code-compliance approval.
limit.sr: Idealna ravanska rešetka uz zadate oslonce i sile; bez potvrde štapova, spojeva ili usklađenosti sa propisima.

description.en: Weighted paths through a grid; an algorithm, not an evacuation assessment.
description.sr: Ponderisani putevi na mreži; algoritam, bez procene stvarne evakuacije.

limit.en: Weighted grid paths; no calibrated crowd dynamics, evacuation time or safety assessment.
limit.sr: Ponderisane putanje na mreži; bez kalibrisane dinamike gužve, vremena evakuacije ili procene bezbednosti.

description.en: A teaching toolpath preview. Generated text is not a printer-ready manufacturing file.
description.sr: Nastavni prikaz putanje. Generisani tekst nije fajl spreman za proizvodnju.

limit.en: A teaching path preview, not a printer-ready file. A real process needs machine-specific preparation and verification.
limit.sr: Nastavni prikaz putanje, ne fajl spreman za štampač. Stvaran proces traži pripremu i proveru za konkretnu mašinu.

description.en: A pilot map of Belgrade read as a passport: pick the sources you have, and see what is answered, unreachable, or never written down.
description.sr: Pilot mapa Beograda čitana kao pasoš: izaberi izvore koje imaš i vidi šta je odgovoreno, šta nedostupno, a šta nikada nije zapisano.

limit.en: Hand-placed river lines and a teaching dataset: three landmarks from general literature, two cases constructed for class. No cadastre, no certification, no reuse permit.
limit.sr: Rukom postavljene osovine reka i nastavni skup podataka: tri repera iz opšte literature, dva slučaja konstruisana za čas. Bez katastra, sertifikata i dozvole za ponovnu upotrebu.
